description: Optionally tell Port66 the transaction hash of the buyer's deposit for a purchase, so NEAR Intents spots the payment sooner. Not required: deposits are detected on their own. Does not move money or change the amount due. Returns the purchase's current state. Safe to call more than once. Requires a Port66 session.

tx_hash.description: The hash (transaction id) of the deposit the buyer sent, as shown by their wallet or a block explorer.

name: report_deposit
title: Report a deposit
